resolution_source_risk: Endorsements are counted directly from public Truth Social posts; low miss risk, though borderline wording calls require judgment.
rationale: The final weekly count depends on how many people Trump chooses to endorse over days that, as of the judgment date, have not all occurred yet -- a spontaneous, not-yet-made decision rather than a private fact already known to a small circle. Each individual post is also immediately public the moment it happens, so there is no meaningful private-knowledge window even for the already-elapsed portion of the week.
